# Romanian rows of the World Loanword Database

Source: Kim Schulte. 2009. Romanian vocabulary. In: Haspelmath, Martin & Tadmor, Uri (eds.) World Loanword Database. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology. CLDF edition: https://github.com/lexibank/wold (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Only the form, the borrowed status and the donor languoids are kept here.
